title: tetragonanthus deflexus var. heteranthus
intro: Tetragonanthus deflexus var. heteranthus, commonly known as African pear, is a plant species within the family Apocynaceae, characterized by its unique pear-shaped fruits. The health benefits of African pear include its potential in reducing inflammation, improving immune function, and acting as an antioxidant. The therapeutic actions of this plant are attributed to its analgesic, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents of African pear include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
